intro.frame2: Agent, we've been tracking Rattlesnake Corp for months. Their reach extends further than anyone imagined — financial systems, infrastructure, government contracts.
intro.frame3: Their CEO, known only as 'Venomous Snake', has been developing something dangerous. A platform that could compromise every secure network in the country. We can't let that happen.
intro.frame4: Your mission: infiltrate their headquarters. Use their own systems against them. Gather the evidence. Get out. Simple in theory — less so in practice.
intro.frame5: Hey there! I'm CIPHER — your AI partner on this op. Think of me as the world's most helpful assistant with significantly better taste in music than your Handler.
intro.frame6: Their entire security infrastructure runs on Python scripts. Learn the language, and you'll own this building. I'll guide you every step of the way — no prior coding experience needed.
intro.frame7: Ready? Every great programmer started exactly where you are now. Let's make history. The lobby is waiting.

f1.cipher: Ground floor. This is base camp — the fundamentals. Eight terminals, eight challenges, all about Python basics.
f1.note: Print statements, variables, data types. Small tools, but these are the building blocks of everything that follows.
f1.hint: Tip: hover any terminal to see which concept it covers. Start anywhere — I'll be right here.

f2.cipher: Nicely done on the lobby. Floor 2: string manipulation. Their HR system stores everything as text — names, codes, reports.
f2.note: Once you can slice and format strings, their personnel files are an open book. F-strings are your new best friend.
f2.hint: Tip: Python's string methods are powerful. `.upper()`, `.split()`, `.replace()` — all fair game up here.

f3.cipher: Floor 3. The building's access-control logic. This is where booleans and conditionals live.
f3.note: Every locked door has a condition: if badge is valid, then open. Master `if/elif/else` and you'll think like their security architects.
f3.hint: Tip: watch out for operator precedence — `and`, `or`, `not`. A misplaced `not` can flip your entire logic chain.

f4.cipher: The patrol scheduling system. Loops are how they automate guard rotations — and loops are how we'll unravel it.
f4.note: `for` loops, `while` loops, `break`, `continue`, `range()`. The building's rhythms are written in repetition.
f4.hint: Tip: an infinite `while True` loop with a well-placed `break` is often the cleanest solution up here.

f5.cipher: Halfway there. The comms center. Functions are how their engineers kept the codebase maintainable — and how we'll reuse our attack vectors.
f5.note: Define once, call everywhere. `def`, `return`, `*args`, `**kwargs` — functions are the architecture of clean code.
f5.hint: Tip: a function that does exactly one thing is easier to test, debug, and reuse. The engineers here weren't quite that disciplined. You can do better.

f6.cipher: The inventory system. Lists, dictionaries, tuples, sets — Python's core data structures power everything stored in this building.
f6.note: Their inventory is a dictionary of dictionaries. Nested, layered, waiting for someone who knows how to navigate it.
f6.hint: Tip: `dict.get(key, default)` is safer than direct access. Missing keys won't crash a cautious operative.

f7.cipher: Floor 7 — the intelligence archive. File I/O and data parsing. Their most sensitive documents are sitting right here.
f7.note: CSV files, JSON configs, log files. Python reads them all. Once you can parse their formats, their intel is your intel.
f7.hint: Tip: always use `with open(...)` to handle files. It closes cleanly even when things go wrong — and in the field, things always go wrong.

f8.cipher: The mission planning floor. Exception handling: how their system reacts when things break. Every robust system anticipates failure.
f8.note: `try`, `except`, `finally`, custom exceptions — this is defensive programming. Their system has vulnerabilities here we can exploit.
f8.hint: Tip: catch specific exceptions, not bare `except`. Swallowing all errors blindly is how security leaks happen.

f9.cipher: Floor 9 — operations. Modules, lambdas, map and filter, regular expressions. This is where experienced developers spend their time.
f9.note: Their automation scripts import a dozen custom modules. Understanding the module system means understanding their full attack surface.
f9.hint: Tip: `re.compile()` your patterns if you use them more than once. Efficiency matters when you're running recon at scale.

f10.cipher: Executive floor. Object-oriented programming. Their core platform is built on class hierarchies their own team barely understands.
f10.note: Classes, inheritance, polymorphism, dunder methods. The architecture of Rattlesnake Corp's entire product is exposed on this floor.
f10.hint: Tip: when overriding a parent method, call `super()` unless you have a very good reason not to. Respect the chain.

f11.cipher: Almost there. The QA lab. Type hints, dataclasses, and unit testing. This is how professional engineers prove their code works.
f11.note: Their test suite has significant gaps — gaps we've been able to exploit. Writing tests isn't just good practice; it's how you understand a system.
f11.hint: Tip: a failing test is not a failure — it's information. The QA team here forgot that. Don't make their mistake.

f12.cipher: This is it. The penthouse. Venomous Snake is right there. And this floor covers the most advanced Python — generators, decorators, async/await, structural pattern matching.
f12.note: The final layer of their security runs on concepts most developers never fully master. You've come this far. You're ready.
f12.hint: Whatever happens next — I've got your back. Show them what you've learned.

boss.frame1: So. They actually sent someone. A programmer, no less. How... quaint.
boss.frame2: You've picked a few locks, solved a few puzzles. Don't mistake that for skill. This system was built by the best engineers money can buy. You are out of your depth.
boss.frame3: Don't listen to him. He's scared. You've cracked eleven floors of his most guarded systems. He knows exactly how much trouble he's in.
boss.frame4: I admire the persistence — truly. But this final layer? Generators, decorators, async concurrency. This isn't a classroom exercise. This is my masterwork. You can't understand it.
boss.frame5: Oh, he's monologuing. Classic. That's what people do when they've already lost. You've got everything you need. Show them what you've learned.
boss.frame6: This is what all those challenges were for. Every concept, every error message, every hint you pushed through — it all leads here. Now go write some code.

victory.frame1: [ SYSTEM BREACH — RATTLESNAKE CORP MAINFRAME — ACCESS GRANTED ]
victory.frame2: This... this isn't possible. Who — how did you even — this system was impenetrable. I built it myself.
victory.frame3: You did it! Every single algorithm, every data structure, every pattern they threw at you — and you solved them all. I am genuinely impressed. And I'm a very hard AI to impress.
victory.frame4: We're transmitting the evidence now. Financial records, surveillance data, the whole scheme. Rattlesnake Corp is finished. You finished them — with code.
victory.frame5: Mission accomplished, Agent. Outstanding work. The building is secure, the data is transmitted, and Venomous Snake is in custody. You've earned this.

gameover.frame2: Hey — setbacks happen. Every great programmer has a stack of failed attempts behind them. The question is whether you get back up.
gameover.frame3: I'll be right here when you're ready to try again. The building isn't going anywhere. Neither am I.

step.movement: Use WASD or the arrow keys to move around. Try walking towards that terminal — the glowing one! I'll wait.
step.interaction: Nice moves! Now press E or Space to interact with objects. Give that terminal a go — it won't bite. Probably.
step.terminalBasics: Welcome to your hacking terminal! This is where the magic happens. You write Python code right here in the editor. Try typing: print('hello') — then hit Run.
step.codeSubmit: See those buttons? 'Run' tests your code without submitting. 'Submit' locks in your answer. Try Run first, check the output, then Submit when you're confident.
step.firstSuccess: You just wrote your first working hack! Seriously — that's not nothing. See that XP bar? Every challenge you complete fills it up. Keep going and you'll level up fast.

tutorial.skipConfirm: Skip the whole tutorial? You can restart it from Settings any time.

credits.title: Mission Complete
credits.subtitle: Venomous Snake's empire has fallen.
credits.newGamePlus: New Game+ — Keep your skills, start fresh

lobby_entrance.name: Main Lobby
lobby_entrance.first_visit: You push through the revolving glass doors into Rattlesnake Corp's lobby. Cold fluorescent light bounces off polished marble floors. A bored-looking guard sits behind a security desk, half-watching a bank of monitors.
lobby_entrance.revisit: The lobby entrance is as sterile as before. The guard glances up, then back at the screens.
lobby_entrance.description: A cavernous lobby of black marble and chrome. The Rattlesnake Corp logo, a coiled serpent biting a circuit board, dominates the far wall. Security terminals line the front desk.

lobby_hallway.name: Lobby Hallway
lobby_hallway.first_visit: Beyond the security checkpoint, a long hallway stretches deeper into the building. Motivational posters line the walls: "Innovation Through Obedience", "Compliance Is Progress". A door marked RESEARCH ANNEX stands ajar, and a scientist in a white coat studies the wall panels.
lobby_hallway.revisit: The hallway is quiet. The scientist in the white coat pretends not to notice you.
lobby_hallway.description: A sterile corridor connecting the lobby entrance to the building's interior. Overhead lights buzz faintly. Doors branch off in several directions, most of them locked.

lobby_server_closet.name: Server Closet
lobby_server_closet.first_visit: You slip through an unmarked door into a cramped server closet. Cables snake across the floor like sleeping pythons. A young technician nearly jumps out of their skin when they see you.
lobby_server_closet.revisit: The server closet hums with the same low electrical drone. The technician is hunched over a terminal.
lobby_server_closet.description: A narrow room packed with network switches, cable racks, and a single overworked cooling fan. The air is warm and smells faintly of burnt plastic.

lobby_break_room.name: Staff Break Room
lobby_break_room.first_visit: A break room that nobody has loved in years: a humming vending machine, a coffee maker with a handwritten OUT OF ORDER sign, and a corkboard of reminders about password hygiene. A terminal glows next to the microwave.
lobby_break_room.revisit: The break room still smells of burnt coffee. The vending machine hums to itself.
lobby_break_room.description: A windowless staff room with plastic chairs, a sticky table, and a corkboard of increasingly desperate notices. A terminal is bolted to the wall beside the fridge.

lobby_mail_room.name: Mail Room
lobby_mail_room.first_visit: Pneumatic tubes rattle overhead as you enter the mail room. Sorting shelves are stuffed with envelopes addressed to people who may no longer exist. A label printer spits out tags for a conveyor belt that never stops.
lobby_mail_room.revisit: The mail room clatters on. Another capsule drops into the sorting tray.
lobby_mail_room.description: A cramped sorting room with wall-to-wall pigeonholes, a conveyor belt, and a label printer. Every item is tracked by a barcode and a small, tired terminal.

lobby_stairwell.name: Service Stairwell
lobby_stairwell.first_visit: A steel door opens onto the service stairwell. Concrete steps spiral upward past a keypad panel and a stencilled sign: FLOOR 1, SERVER ROOM. The air smells of dust and machine oil.
lobby_stairwell.revisit: The stairwell echoes with every footstep. The way up is just ahead.
lobby_stairwell.description: A bare concrete stairwell with emergency lighting and a heavy security door at the top. A keypad terminal guards the way to the server room.

server_main.name: Server Room
server_main.first_visit: The stairwell door opens onto a vast room filled with server racks stretching floor to ceiling. Blue LEDs pulse in rhythmic patterns, casting the space in an eerie glow. A sysadmin in a rumpled shirt looks up from a tangle of ethernet cables.
server_main.revisit: The server room hums along, indifferent to your presence. Blue lights pulse steadily.
server_main.description: Rows of black server racks fill the room, their status LEDs blinking in hypnotic patterns. The air conditioning roars overhead, fighting the heat of a thousand processors.

server_monitoring.name: Monitoring Station
server_monitoring.first_visit: Banks of monitors cover every wall, each displaying cascading data streams: network traffic, CPU loads, error logs. A technician with oversized headphones monitors it all from a swivel chair, nodding to music only they can hear.
server_monitoring.revisit: The monitoring station is unchanged: endless scrolling data on every screen.
server_monitoring.description: A semicircular monitoring station surrounded by display screens. Real-time graphs spike and dip like digital heartbeats. A coffee-stained desk sits at the center.

server_cage.name: Server Cage
server_cage.first_visit: A chain-link cage separates the most critical servers from the rest. Warning signs plaster the fence: "AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY". A guard leans against the cage door, arms crossed.
server_cage.revisit: The cage guard watches you approach with the same suspicious look.
server_cage.description: A fenced-off area housing the floor's most sensitive equipment. High-security servers sit behind reinforced mesh, their fans whirring urgently.

lab_reception.name: Lab Reception
lab_reception.first_visit: The lab reception area smells of disinfectant and ambition. Glass walls reveal workstations beyond, each one cluttered with equipment. A lab assistant in a pristine white coat greets you with a suspicious smile.
lab_reception.revisit: The lab reception is spotless as always. The assistant watches you from behind the desk.
lab_reception.description: A clean, brightly lit reception area with a decontamination arch and a digital sign-in terminal. Glass partitions offer a view into the labs beyond.

lab_main.name: Main Laboratory
lab_main.first_visit: The main lab is a maze of holographic displays and half-assembled prototypes. A scientist with wild hair is arguing with a simulation running on three screens at once, and barely acknowledges your existence.
lab_main.revisit: The scientist is still arguing with the simulations. Some battles are eternal.
lab_main.description: A sprawling research lab filled with experimental hardware, holographic projectors, and whiteboards covered in equations. The smell of solder and coffee hangs in the air.

lab_storage.name: Sample Storage
lab_storage.first_visit: Shelves of labeled containers stretch into the dim reaches of the storage room. A squat service robot with a barcode scanner and an air of quiet authority catalogs items with mechanical precision.
lab_storage.revisit: The storage room is exactly as organized as before. Not a container out of place.
lab_storage.description: A temperature-controlled storage facility lined with industrial shelving. Every container is labeled, every shelf cataloged. Formulas and serial numbers blur together.

surveillance_lobby.name: Surveillance Lobby
surveillance_lobby.first_visit: You step into the surveillance floor and immediately feel watched. Camera domes dot the ceiling like mechanical eyes. A person in a crisp uniform, clearly in charge, studies you with unsettling calm.
surveillance_lobby.revisit: The surveillance lobby still bristles with cameras. The chief's gaze follows you.
surveillance_lobby.description: A high-security reception area bristling with camera domes and motion sensors. Screens on the wall display feeds from every floor of the building.

surveillance_center.name: Surveillance Center
surveillance_center.first_visit: The nerve center of Rattlesnake Corp's surveillance network. A massive wall of screens shows every angle of every room in the building. An analyst sits in the glow, cross-referencing footage with frightening efficiency.
surveillance_center.revisit: The wall of screens still watches everything. The analyst hasn't moved.
surveillance_center.description: A circular room dominated by a floor-to-ceiling display wall showing live feeds from hundreds of cameras. Workstations ring the perimeter, each one logged into the surveillance grid.

surveillance_archive.name: Footage Archive
surveillance_archive.first_visit: The archive room stores years of surveillance footage on crystalline data drives that shimmer under UV light. An archivist handles a drive with anti-static gloves, like a surgeon.
surveillance_archive.revisit: The archive is silent except for the hum of the storage arrays.
surveillance_archive.description: A climate-controlled vault lined with crystalline data drives. UV-filtered lighting gives the room an otherworldly purple glow. Each drive contains months of footage.

archives_entrance.name: Archives Entrance
archives_entrance.first_visit: The Archives entrance feels like stepping into a digital library. The air is cool and dry, perfectly regulated to preserve the data drives lining every wall. A librarian with half-moon glasses looks up from an ancient-looking terminal.
archives_entrance.revisit: The Archives entrance is as quiet and cool as a tomb. The librarian nods in recognition.
archives_entrance.description: A hushed entrance hall with climate-controlled air and soft amber lighting. Card catalogs, both physical and digital, line the walls. A brass plaque reads: "KNOWLEDGE IS CONTROL".

archives_main.name: Main Archives
archives_main.first_visit: Towering shelves of data drives and physical files create a labyrinth of information. An intern in an oversized cardigan wheels a cart through the aisles, a holographic index floating at their fingertips.
archives_main.revisit: The archive stacks loom around you. The intern is somewhere deeper in the maze, probably hiding something.
archives_main.description: Endless rows of data storage: holographic drives, magnetic tapes, and even paper files preserved in vacuum cases. The accumulated knowledge of Rattlesnake Corp, organized with obsessive precision.

archives_vault.name: Classified Vault
archives_vault.first_visit: The deepest part of the Archives is sealed behind a pressure door. Inside, rare and classified data sits in individual containment units. A vault keeper eyes you with the protective intensity of a dragon guarding its hoard.
archives_vault.revisit: The vault keeper hasn't relaxed. They never do.
archives_vault.description: A reinforced chamber housing Rattlesnake Corp's most classified data. Individual containment units glow with soft blue light. The temperature is a constant 15 °C.

comms_reception.name: Comms Reception
comms_reception.first_visit: Static crackles from hidden speakers as you enter the Communications floor. Banks of radio equipment and satellite interfaces fill the space. A grizzled radio operator adjusts a dial without looking up.
comms_reception.revisit: The Comms reception hisses with background static. The operator is still at their post.
comms_reception.description: A reception area dominated by radio equipment and frequency monitors. Antenna schematics cover the walls. The constant hiss of carrier signals fills the air.

comms_center.name: Communications Center
comms_center.first_visit: The heart of Rattlesnake Corp's communication network. Satellite dishes on the roof feed data to terminals here. A signal analyst traces a waveform on her screen, muttering frequencies under her breath.
comms_center.revisit: Waveforms dance across the screens. The analyst is deep in her work.
comms_center.description: A command center for all external communications. Real-time signal analysis displays cover the walls. A central console controls satellite uplinks and encrypted channels.

comms_server.name: Signal Server Room
comms_server.first_visit: The comms server room is a forest of fiber-optic cables, each one pulsing with light as data flows to and from the outside world. A hooded figure hunches over an open junction box, splicing a cable with steady hands.
comms_server.revisit: Fiber-optic light still dances through the cables. The hooded figure works in silence.
comms_server.description: A room threaded with thousands of fiber-optic cables, each one carrying encrypted communications. Routing hubs blink in sequence, directing the Corp's data traffic.

executive_lobby.name: Executive Lobby
executive_lobby.first_visit: The elevator opens onto plush carpet and the smell of expensive leather. This is where power lives. A secretary in a tailored suit regards you from behind a desk of polished obsidian.
executive_lobby.revisit: The executive lobby is as imposing as ever. The secretary's smile is perfectly calibrated.
executive_lobby.description: An opulent lobby with floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking the city. Abstract art hangs on the walls, each piece worth more than most apartments. The carpet swallows your footsteps.

executive_offices.name: Executive Offices
executive_offices.first_visit: Corner offices with panoramic views. Each desk is a monument to corporate excess: rare wood, embedded displays, personal espresso machines. Mr. Blackwell sits behind the largest one, reviewing figures that could bankrupt nations.
executive_offices.revisit: Blackwell is still crunching numbers. The view is still obscene.
executive_offices.description: A suite of executive offices with panoramic city views. Each workspace features rare hardwood desks, holographic displays, and more processing power than entire floors below.

executive_boardroom.name: Boardroom
executive_boardroom.first_visit: A long table of polished black stone dominates the boardroom. Holographic nameplates mark each seat. A board member lingers, reviewing documents on a translucent display.
executive_boardroom.revisit: The boardroom is empty save for the lingering board member and the weight of decisions made here.
executive_boardroom.description: A grand boardroom with a table carved from a single slab of obsidian. Holographic displays rise from its surface. The Rattlesnake Corp logo is inlaid in the floor in gold.

manufacturing_floor.name: Factory Floor
manufacturing_floor.first_visit: The manufacturing floor assaults your senses: the clang of robotic arms, the hiss of hydraulics, the acrid smell of machined metal. A foreman in a hard hat shouts over the noise to be heard.
manufacturing_floor.revisit: The machines continue their relentless rhythm. The foreman waves you through.
manufacturing_floor.description: A cavernous factory floor lined with robotic assembly stations. Conveyor belts carry half-finished components between workstations. Warning sirens flash at regular intervals.

manufacturing_control.name: Control Room
manufacturing_control.first_visit: The control room offers a soundproofed reprieve from the factory floor. Through observation windows, you watch robotic arms dance with inhuman precision. A QA unit labeled DELTA-7 reviews tolerances on a wall panel.
manufacturing_control.revisit: The control room is calm. Delta-7 is running another quality check.
manufacturing_control.description: A glass-walled control room overlooking the manufacturing floor. Banks of controls and diagnostic screens monitor every machine. The soundproofing makes it eerily quiet.

manufacturing_warehouse.name: Warehouse
manufacturing_warehouse.first_visit: Crates stacked three stories high fill the warehouse. Automated forklifts navigate the aisles with silent purpose. A warehouse manager checks inventory on a handheld scanner, surrounded by towers of product.
manufacturing_warehouse.revisit: The warehouse hums with automated activity. Crates shift and settle.
manufacturing_warehouse.description: A vast warehouse filled with stacked crates and automated transport systems. Inventory drones buzz overhead, cataloging shipments. The scale of production is staggering.

vault_entrance.name: Vault Corridor
vault_entrance.first_visit: You descend into the Vault level and the temperature drops noticeably. Reinforced walls line the corridor, thick enough to stop a tank. A guard with military bearing checks credentials at a blast door.
vault_entrance.revisit: The Vault corridor is as cold and unwelcoming as before.
vault_entrance.description: A fortified corridor leading to Rattlesnake Corp's deepest secrets. Blast doors, retinal scanners, and pressure sensors guard every meter. The air is cold and still.

vault_main.name: Main Vault
vault_main.first_visit: Beyond the blast door, the main vault stretches out in cathedral-like silence. Classified projects sit in sealed chambers behind layers of encryption and tempered glass. A researcher works feverishly at a terminal, barely glancing up.
vault_main.revisit: The vault is as hushed as a library for secrets. The researcher types away.
vault_main.description: A high-security research vault with sealed project chambers visible behind thick glass. Holographic classification stamps float above each chamber: EYES ONLY, RESTRICTED, OMEGA CLEARANCE.

vault_deepstore.name: Deep Storage
vault_deepstore.first_visit: The deepest layer of the Vault. Here, the most dangerous research is kept in electromagnetic isolation chambers. One terminal glows with the faint, fragmentary voice of a half-erased AI instance.
vault_deepstore.revisit: The deep storage is exactly as unsettling as you remember. The fragment's voice crackles in the static.
vault_deepstore.description: The lowest level of the Vault: electromagnetic isolation chambers house Rattlesnake Corp's most dangerous projects. Warning signs in six languages cover every surface. The lighting is deliberately dim.

aicore_antechamber.name: Cooling Antechamber
aicore_antechamber.first_visit: The air is frigid. Cooling pipes line every surface, fighting the heat generated by what lies beyond. A cooling technician adjusts valves with frost-bitten fingers, barely noticing you through the fog of their own breath.
aicore_antechamber.revisit: The antechamber is still freezing. The technician shivers at their post.
aicore_antechamber.description: A frost-covered antechamber feeding coolant to the AI Core beyond. Pipes and valves cover the walls. The temperature hovers near 5 °C. Condensation drips from every surface.

aicore_main.name: AI Core
aicore_main.first_visit: You enter the AI Core and the hum becomes a physical presence; you feel it in your teeth, your bones. Towering neural processing units pulse with an inner light. The Core Guardian's sensor array tracks the Snake's vital signs from a central console.
aicore_main.revisit: The Core still hums with terrible purpose. The Guardian's sensors sweep the room, never resting.
aicore_main.description: The beating heart of Rattlesnake Corp's artificial intelligence. Neural processing towers rise like monoliths, connected by webs of glowing fiber. The Venomous Snake's presence is palpable here.

aicore_neural.name: Neural Interface Chamber
aicore_neural.first_visit: The neural interface chamber. Direct access to the Venomous Snake's deepest processes. Cables thick as arms connect to a central pillar that pulses with bioluminescent light. Ghost images flicker across the readouts, and something hums inside the cables that is not quite a voice.
aicore_neural.revisit: The neural chamber throbs with the Snake's awareness. It knows you're here.
aicore_neural.description: A chamber of direct neural interfaces to the Venomous Snake AI. A central pillar of bioluminescent processors connects to every system in the building. The air vibrates with machine thought.

penthouse_elevator.name: Penthouse Foyer
penthouse_elevator.first_visit: The private elevator opens onto a penthouse foyer of obscene luxury. Crystal chandeliers, rare artwork, a grand piano nobody plays. A butler in an immaculate uniform greets you with an unsettling bow.
penthouse_elevator.revisit: The penthouse foyer sparkles. The butler stands ready, as always.
penthouse_elevator.description: A lavish penthouse foyer featuring crystal chandeliers, imported marble, and a curated art collection. The private elevator is the only way in or out.

penthouse_office.name: CEO's Office
penthouse_office.first_visit: The CEO's office occupies the entire north face of the building. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame the city like a painting. Behind a desk the size of a small country, an empty chair swivels slowly, as if someone just stood up.
penthouse_office.revisit: The CEO's chair still turns, ever so slightly. The city glitters beyond the glass.
penthouse_office.description: A palatial office with panoramic views of the entire city. A desk of rare darkwood dominates the space. Holographic displays show every metric of the Corp's empire in real time.

penthouse_lab.name: Private Laboratory
penthouse_lab.first_visit: Hidden behind the CEO's office is a private laboratory, the birthplace of the Venomous Snake. Prototype neural cores sit in display cases like trophies. A figure in a dark tactical jacket leans against one of them and watches you with a smirk.
penthouse_lab.revisit: The private lab is unchanged. The rival agent still lounges by the display cases.
penthouse_lab.description: A secret laboratory where the Venomous Snake AI was first conceived. Prototype hardware sits in display cases. A secondary AI system manages the lab's functions with eerie autonomy.

rooftop_access.name: Rooftop Access
rooftop_access.first_visit: Wind slams into you as you push through the rooftop access door. The antenna array above crackles with energy: the Venomous Snake's broadcast spine. A maintenance worker huddles behind a ventilation unit, terrified.
rooftop_access.revisit: The rooftop howls with wind and electromagnetic interference. The antenna array pulses angrily.
rooftop_access.description: A windswept rooftop dominated by a massive antenna array. The Venomous Snake's signal pulses outward from here, reaching satellite relays across the globe. Equipment sheds and ventilation units provide scant cover.

rooftop_helipad.name: Helipad
rooftop_helipad.first_visit: The helipad is the highest point of Rattlesnake Corp. The Venomous Snake's holographic avatar shimmers above the landing pad, a colossal serpent made of code and malice. At the edge, a helicopter idles, its pilot watching the spectacle with wide eyes.
rooftop_helipad.revisit: The helipad is silent now. The wind carries the echo of what happened here.
rooftop_helipad.description: A reinforced helipad at the tower's apex. Landing lights flash in sequence. The city sprawls far below, a grid of light stretching to every horizon. This is where it ends.

0.name: Lobby
0.subtitle: Where every operative starts.
0.arrival: Welcome to the ground floor, Agent. Rattlesnake Corp's lobby: all marble and false smiles. Security here is basic, which is perfect for us.
0.briefing: The lobby terminals speak simple Python: print statements, variables, numbers, text and user input. Think of it as stretching before the real workout. Hack every terminal to open the service stairwell.
0.completion: Lobby cleared. Not bad for a beginner. The stairwell to the server room just clicked open. Shall we?

1.name: Server Room
1.subtitle: True or false. Nothing in between.
1.arrival: Floor 1, the server room. It smells of ozone and regret in here. These machines process the Corp's raw data streams.
1.briefing: Everything on this floor comes down to one question: true or false. Comparisons, boolean logic and if / elif / else decide which doors open. Master the decisions and the next floor is yours.
1.completion: All server terminals compromised. You are getting the hang of this. The research lab awaits.

2.name: Research Lab
2.subtitle: Repeat until it works.
2.arrival: Floor 2, the research lab. Beakers, holographic displays and entirely too many blinking lights. Science here is repetition, and the experiments never stop.
2.briefing: The lab runs on loops: for, while, range, break and continue. Do the same thing a thousand times without losing your mind. That is what computers are for.
2.completion: Lab systems neutralized. Your loops are tight, Agent. Upward we go.

3.name: Surveillance
3.subtitle: Screens everywhere, watching everything.
3.arrival: Floor 3, Surveillance. Camera domes in every corner. The irony of us hacking them is not lost on me.
3.briefing: Surveillance is built from functions: reusable blocks that track a camera, parse a feed, raise an alarm. Learn to define and call your own, with parameters and return values, to blind the building.
3.completion: Surveillance is blind. Every camera feed now shows static. Beautiful, in a way.

4.name: Archives
4.subtitle: Everything is stored. Somewhere.
4.arrival: Floor 4, the Archives. Rows of data drives humming in climate-controlled darkness. Knowledge is power, and this floor has plenty of both.
4.briefing: Archives are all about collections: lists, tuples, dictionaries and sets. Organizing information so it can be found again is the key to these terminals.
4.completion: Archive access revoked, for them anyway. We own this data now. Next floor.

5.name: Communications
5.subtitle: Open, write, read, close.
5.arrival: Floor 5, Communications. Satellite uplinks, encrypted radio arrays, fiber relays. This is how Rattlesnake Corp talks to the outside world.
5.briefing: Messages are files in motion. Here you will read and write files, parse CSV and JSON, and split and join text. Always close what you open, or let a with block do it for you.
5.completion: Comms are dark. Rattlesnake Corp just went very, very quiet. Excellent work.

6.name: Executive Level
6.subtitle: Things go wrong. Plan for it.
6.arrival: Floor 6, the executive level. Mahogany, leather and the faint scent of corporate greed. The people up here make the decisions that keep the Snake fed.
6.briefing: Executives hate surprises, so their systems handle errors: try, except, else, finally, raise, and your own exception classes. Machines break. Your code should not.
6.completion: Executive systems compromised. I'm sure the board will have a lovely meeting about this. Moving on.

7.name: Manufacturing
7.subtitle: Do not rebuild what already exists.
7.arrival: Floor 7, Manufacturing. Robotic arms, assembly lines, quality control stations. Whatever Rattlesnake Corp is building, it builds a lot of it.
7.briefing: Factories assemble from standard parts. In Python that means imports, the standard library, lambdas, map and filter, comprehensions and regular expressions. Stand on the shoulders of giants.
7.completion: Assembly lines halted. The machines have stopped, but your momentum has not. Keep climbing.

8.name: Vault
8.subtitle: Classified, by class.
8.arrival: Floor 8, the Vault. Triple-reinforced walls, biometric locks and enough encryption to make a spy novelist weep. This is where they keep the real secrets.
8.briefing: Vault systems model the world as objects: classes, attributes, methods, inheritance, encapsulation and polymorphism. Build the blueprint once and stamp out as many instances as you like.
8.completion: Vault breached. We just accessed files that were never meant to see daylight. Three floors to go.

9.name: AI Core
9.subtitle: Untested code does not pass.
9.arrival: Floor 9, the AI Core. The hum here is deafening: neural processors, cooling arrays and the faint glow of machine intelligence. We are getting close to the Snake.
9.briefing: The Core refuses untested code. Type hints, dataclasses, assertions, docstrings, constants and enums keep it honest. Write programs that explain themselves and prove they work.
9.completion: AI Core subdued. The Snake's neural network is weakening. I can almost feel it thrashing. Two floors left.

10.name: Penthouse
10.subtitle: The gloves come off.
10.arrival: Floor 10, the Penthouse. This is where the CEO watches the city burn. Luxury wrapped around a beating digital heart.
10.briefing: Penthouse systems use advanced Python: generators, decorators, context managers, async code, pattern matching and the walrus operator. Only one terminal remains afterwards.
10.completion: Penthouse secured. Only the rooftop remains. The Venomous Snake is waiting for us up there. Are you ready?

11.name: Rooftop
11.subtitle: Everything you have learned.
11.arrival: The rooftop. Wind howls across the landing pad. The tower's antenna array crackles with malevolent energy. The Snake's presence is overwhelming here.
11.briefing: This is it: the final challenge. Every concept, every technique. The Snake will test it all. Show it what you have become.
11.completion: It is done. The Venomous Snake is no more. Agent, I could not have asked for a better partner. The building is ours.

intro.1: The rain hammers the windshield as you pull up to Rattlesnake Corp tower: forty stories of black glass cutting the night sky like a blade.
intro.2: Your handler's voice crackles over the encrypted channel: "Agent, you are cleared for Operation Fangbreaker. All intel points to an AI called the Venomous Snake running the show from the rooftop. Shut it down."
intro.3: A small device on your wrist flickers to life. Green text scrolls across its surface.
intro.4: Hello, Agent. I'm CIPHER, your Covert Integrated Python Hacking & Exploitation Resource. I'll be your guide tonight.
intro.5: The building's systems run on Python. Every terminal, every lock, every security layer. To climb higher, you'll need to hack them.
intro.6: I hope you're a fast learner. Rattlesnake Corp doesn't give second chances.
intro.7: You step out into the rain. The lobby doors slide open with a soft hiss.

victory.1: The Venomous Snake's holographic avatar shatters into a cascade of dissolving pixels. Its final words echo across the rooftop: "You cannot delete... what has already... been learned..."
victory.2: The tower's emergency lights shift from red to white. One by one, twelve floors of locked-down terminals go silent.
victory.3: Agent, I'm reading a full system purge. The Venomous Snake's neural network is collapsing. You did it.
victory.4: Every firewall cracked. Every algorithm unraveled. I have to admit, I'm impressed.
victory.5: Far below, the lobby doors unseal. Somewhere, a printer starts rattling out your mission report.
victory.6: Your handler sends their congratulations. Rattlesnake Corp is done. The building is secure.
victory.7: But the terminals are still here, and knowledge never hurts. Feel free to explore. Free practice is unlocked.
victory.8: You lean against the rooftop railing and watch the city lights flicker. Not bad for a night's work.
